whatIsSection.title: What Is the Golden Visa in Dubai?
paragraphs: The Golden Visa is a long-term UAE residence permit valid for 5 or 10 years, depending on your eligibility. It offers high-level residency benefits similar to Emirati nationals.

Golden Visa holders can sponsor family, access UAE's healthcare and education services, and enjoy long-term stability without frequent renewals. Unlike regular visas, it ensures flexibility, independence, and long-term residency.

items.q: Can I apply for a Golden Visa if I am not living in the UAE?
items.a: Yes. Golden Visa applications can be made from anywhere in the world through UAE embassies or portals like ICA or GDRFA. Our team assists you remotely.

items.q: What is the minimum investment for a real estate Golden Visa?
items.a: AED 2 million or more in UAE property (off-plan or ready). Property must be held for at least 3 years and registered in your name.

items.q: Can I sponsor my family members?
items.a: Yes. Golden Visa holders can sponsor spouse, children (including adults up to a certain age), parents, and domestic staff.

items.q: How long is the Golden Visa valid?
items.a: 5 or 10 years, depending on your eligibility category. It is renewable without a local sponsor.

items.q: Do I need a local sponsor?
items.a: No. The Golden Visa eliminates the need for a local sponsor, giving you full independence in business and life in the UAE.

items.q: Is a Golden Visa linked to a specific employer?
items.a: No. It is completely independent of any employer or company — you can work, own businesses, or be self-employed freely.

items.q: Can freelancers apply for a Golden Visa?
items.a: Yes, if you qualify under the entrepreneur, talent, or specialized professional categories.

items.q: What happens if I sell my property after getting the visa?
items.a: You must maintain the AED 2M investment to keep the visa. Selling requires reinvestment to remain compliant.

items.q: Will I get an Emirates ID and UAE services?
items.a: Yes. You receive an Emirates ID, access to UAE healthcare, education, banking, and all residential services.
